title: Notification regarding Division bench of Hon'ble Chief Justice and Hon'ble Mr Justice A. Bimol Singh and Single Bench of Hon'ble Mr Justice A. Bimol Singh on 27th October, 2026.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 27th October, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ It is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Division Bench of Hon’ble The Chief Justice and Hon’ble -Mr. Justice A. Bimol
Singh will sit at 11:30 am.
Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh wIll sit at 10:30 am till 11:25 am
and thereafter resume at 2:00 pm on 27th October, 2026.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ JX N g- g% Imphal, the 27th October, 2026
